privacy.ruling: W5.2 coordinator ruling: privacy_scan gained a manifest-pinned binary allowlist (--binary-allowlist, auto-detected at this file). A binary passes the categorical binary_document_ext rule ONLY when its path is listed here AND its sha256 matches; any unlisted binary or hash drift stays HARD (still-catches #1). Allowlisted binaries are still content-scanned (RRN, filled phone, email, user-path, denylist over extracted hwp/hwpx text) - PII in an allowlisted blank is HARD (still-catches #2). Bundles never apply the allowlist: tests/test_package_module.py asserts no corpus member lands in any bundle. Recorded in docs/gate-calibration.md.
privacy.content_check: Offline scan (PrvText for .hwp, all XML/text parts for .hwpx): zero RRN patterns, zero filled phone numbers, zero email addresses in any file. All files verified blank templates via preview text. The same nets now run inside privacy_scan on every allowlisted member.
privacy.metadata_note: Several .hwp files carry issuing-agency author names in HwpSummaryInformation as published by the government source (e.g. 법령정보센터 clerk names). Kept as-is to preserve byte-exact provenance (sha256 above matches the official download); if this is judged unacceptable, strip DocSummary on the operator machine during XC-1 conversion and record new hashes for the converted siblings only.
